sections.section_name: Section B - Very Short Answer (VSA) / Definitions

questions.question_text: Define the primary practical objective of executing a systemic school 'Water Audit'. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: A water audit systematically measures the total daily water volume consumed against literal wastage across school taps, pinpointing leaks to layout efficient conservation strategies.

questions.question_text: State the significance of selecting proper seasoning procedures for raw bamboo before crafting utility items. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Seasoning raw bamboo removes excess moisture and natural sap, which prevents fungal rotting, deters insect infestations, and greatly increases the structural durability of finished products.

questions.question_text: Explain why balanced nutrition and regular vaccination routines are vital in farm animal care. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Balanced nutrition ensures optimum growth and high milk or meat yield, while regular vaccinations protect livestock from deadly infectious diseases, securing farm productivity and animal welfare.

questions.question_text: Imagine you are setting up a small-scale Deep Water Culture (DWC) hydroponic unit in your school lab. Detail the step-by-step practical setup process you must follow. [35-45 words]
questions.answer: First, take a light-proof container and fill it with a balanced, nutrient-rich water solution. Next, insert seedlings into net pots filled with clay pebbles. Finally, submerge the roots and place an aquarium air stone inside to oxygenate the water continuously.
